messages:
mira: Heads-up — planning a terraform apply for staging networking + IAM during the 02:00 UTC change window. This touches VPC peering, route tables, and a couple of IAM roles. Deploybot already queued the run.

deploybot: queued by mira. position=3 in apply-queue. ETA ~20m to run based on current backpressure. Will enforce gatekeeper thresholds (run-time 30m, error-rate 5%).

alex: quick ask — are we pinning provider and module versions for this? last time an upstream minor surprised us.

mira: yes pinning provider to 4.12.1 and modules to tag v2026-02-staging. added provider override in tfvars and lockfile updated.

jen: paste the plan summary pls so SRE oncall can eyeball risk.

mira: plan summary:
```
# 3 to add, 4 to change, 1 to destroy
- module.vpc.aws_route_table_association: 1 change
- module.peering.aws_vpc_peering_connection: 1 add
- aws_iam_role.staging-deployer: 1 change
```
Full diff uploaded to artifact: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/4821/plan.txt

alex: ok. We should canary the peering + IAM change to a single tenant account first (staging-tn1). If successful, scale to the rest. Who runs the canary?

sasha: I can run the canary and watch metrics. I'll be on pager and in the channel.

devon: ops checklist: state lock enabled, remote state snapshot retention increased for 24h, provider pin confirmed, backup snapshot created: s3://redwood-state-backups/staging/2026-03-20-441907.

mira: apply command for canary (will be manual):
```
terraform apply -var-file=staging-tn1.tfvars -lock=true -auto-approve
```
We will target the peering and iam modules first: `-target=module.peering -target=module.iam`

ops-bot: if deploybot abort is triggered, auto-rollforward disabled. Manual rollback required.

jen: rollback plan recap (short):
- abort deploybot if failure at step 1
- restore previous state from snapshot to remote state backend if drift happens
- revert modules to tag v2026-01 and reapply in serial
- Emergency: detach peering, restore old route tables, remove new IAM changes

alex: one more safety: deploybot, can you enforce a per-run token-rate throttle? want to limit concurrent requests to control blast radius.

deploybot: added throttle policy for this run: concurrent-mod-ops=2, token-burst=250. Will pause and notify channel if threshold hit.

mira: schedule: canary start 02:07 UTC, observation window 15m, then gate to full staging 02:25 if no errors or elevated latency.

sasha: I'll monitor logs + perf dashboards. If I see >3% 5m error increase or route flaps, I hit abort and call for rollback.

devon: FYI I've left a manual checklist in runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/staging-apply-2026. Includes exact rollback commands and S3 snapshot keys.

mira: thanks all. Kicking canary in 10. I'll post plan output once apply completes. :thumbsup:
